propositions: Plan review must classify every acceptance-criterion checkbox as either codebase-verifiable or operator-attested, with specific repository evidence for each classification.
Criteria with external evidence must use the exact case-insensitive [operator-attested] tag; missing or malformed tags on external criteria produce findings that prescribe the correct syntax.
Codebase-verifiable criteria carrying the [operator-attested] tag produce findings explaining that ticket comments cannot substitute for repository proof.
Criteria combining both repository proof and outside-world proof must be split into independently certifiable criteria; bundled mixed evidence is rejected.
High-confidence evidence-kind misclassification findings participate in blocking policy, while deterministic keyword detection remains advisory.
